subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should selectedSkillPaths become the persisted GitHub source contract, with legacy sources staying in all-skills mode until explicitly narrowed?
rationale: This changes persisted source configuration and upgrade semantics, so automation should not infer the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge, fix dry-run scoping, drop the merged overlap, and land selected paths as the stored source contract.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Require a smaller implementation or different persistence shape before selected paths become durable source state.

options.title: Pause Selection Policy
options.body: Keep the draft paused if maintainers are not ready to commit to selected GitHub skill paths as product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge, fix dry-run scoping, drop the merged overlap, and land selected paths as the stored source contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the GitHub-backed source sync feature and are the best history-backed owner for the stored-source contract decision.
